reason: Chrome rejected the redirect with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT in a subsequent local reproduction. No completed inspection or latency claim is derived from this attempt.

postRunInventory.meaning: Ten post-run complete unfiltered inventories; control-plane observation, not physical erasure proof.

resolution: Added the exact local source origin to the holding-page access list. Real Chromium testing also required live extension-document validation via runtime.getContexts and POST status polling so Chrome supplies the required Origin header. A separate local mock-controller run reached the warning before the corrected Solari rerun.
